directions.thesis: The sidebar picks a service and the body IS that service. No standing overview; the console home is the last-used service.
tradeoffs: The rail is mute - no counts, no condition - so a reader opens each service to find the one with a problem.
Home is a guess, so two visits can land differently.
Its empty screen is a ranked offer screen, which encodes a product judgement that must be edited rather than re-fed with data.

exactProposals.why: a set of destinations that SURVIVES the body being replaced; the nearest keys are filters over one result set

directions.thesis: A permanent overview above the services is the console's home, and template apps are an OPEN SET reached through one destination rather than a destination each. Three levels: overview, the app set, one app.
directions.primaryCta: Mo Ung dung from the overview's app card
tradeoffs: It stopped being the cheapest. Revision 1 needed 5 new entries and was chosen partly for that; revision 2 needs 6 plus 2 EXTEND, and 7 if the old restingCount rule is held. The whole delta is the catalogue - the third level itself costs nothing.
A set with one member can read as a pointless folder, and today there is exactly one app. The drawing has to earn the folder before template #2 arrives.
It breaks the agreement the other two directions share: B now has a destination that is not a service, so if B wins the axis question reopens for A and C.

existingOwners: FleetRow (whole, including STATUS_TONE where awaiting_dns stays warning)

exactProposals.why: NEW - a standing set of destinations that survives the body being replaced. choice-tab-strip and dual-tabs-toolbar are filters over ONE result set, which is exactly what this axis discards.
NEW - the routed body is the document's one main landmark, marked once for every route. No route in the app has a main today.
NEW - a run of destinations where some members talk ABOUT the others. Order alone says nothing to a screen reader.
NEW - serves BOTH the overview and the app level. Renamed from titled-service-overview-page because one destination stopped being a service.
NEW - the catalogue's row. A cheaper alternative was considered and refused; the refusal is recorded in the lab.
